criteria.name: Small-space fit
criteria.description: Height (fits under low furniture), dock footprint, noise level and how well it handles tight layouts.

criteria.name: Cleaning performance
criteria.description: Suction, pickup on hard floors and rugs, navigation and obstacle avoidance, based on specs and independent tests.

criteria.name: Reliability
criteria.description: Recurring failure patterns in verified owner reviews and forums, build quality, battery longevity.

criteria.name: Safety and certifications
criteria.description: Battery and electrical safety listings (UL/ETL), recall history (CPSC).

criteria.name: Support and warranty
criteria.description: Warranty length, availability of parts and consumables, return policy.

criteria.name: Value
criteria.description: What it delivers for its price compared with other robot vacuums.
